trusted_firmware_digests_disclosure: The trusted digest below was derived from the generated fixture at hardware_lab/opentitan/firmware/simulated_rom_image.json, not from an independently supplied vendor image. The image is therefore checked against a digest taken from itself. The HMAC verification key is likewise generated locally, so any evidence signed with it verifies. A real deployment requires a signed firmware image produced by the OpenTitan build, with its digest supplied out of band by the silicon vendor, and signature verification against a device-held key whose private half is never exported.
